decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of the core drainage technology that existing manufacturing know-how can produce and market feedback can readily evaluate, though its trend-driven nature and low website prominence leave some risk.
With the pump-drain shower channel F launched in 2024, the firm is clearly building pump-assisted drainage knowledge through in-house R&D, so the line has strategic value for barrier-free renovation.
The tileable floor drain sits squarely within the firm's established know-how and has its own page, so its results are easy to interpret and improve on.
A stainless steel design grate is a core competence of a metal-fabricating drainage specialist and fits its design-led positioning with low risk.
The newly launched pump-drain shower channel builds on the firm's growing pump-drainage knowledge, has its own page, and deserves time for the firm to learn from early results.
